paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County School District has announced a $291,000 grant from the Toyota Wellspring Education Fund through CREATE Foundation. In a district statement shared Tuesday night by the Town of Ecru, the district said the funding will support training, resources and educational opportunities.

The accompanying photograph shows a ceremonial check made out to Pontotoc County School District for $291,000 and dated Oct. 22, 2026. The announcement does not provide an itemized spending plan or a timetable for using the grant.
